messages:
Cheng Li: Hey team — want to schedule a short readout next week to go over the latest inference perf runs and the cost/latency tradeoffs. Goal: 25–30m update + quick decision on the quantization experiments we should promote. Who's available?
Emma Rogers: +1. Prefer Wed or Thu afternoon PT. 30m constraint is great.
Samir Patel: Thu afternoon is tough for me (all hands). Wed 3pm PT works.
Lina Garcia: I can own the latency/cost slides if someone can drop the dashboard links and final CSVs.
Maria Ortiz: Product will join for the customer-impact slide — please include p95 and tail behavior, and any perf regressions vs. last stable.
Cheng Li: Thanks — Lina can you take the dashboards? @bench-bot can you post the latest export and the run IDs we need for the appendix?
bench-bot: Here are the artifacts: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/latency-cost?run=2026-03-10 and export: s3://ci-exports/infer-runs/2026-03-10/metrics.csv
bench-bot: Topline: baseline (fp16) p50=42ms p95=125ms cost@1Mtokens=$18.2; q4-8bit candidate p50=46ms p95=138ms cost@1Mtokens=$10.6 (detailed per-shard in CSV)
Samir Patel: Can we include a quick comparison of batching settings? Last time batching shaved off ~20% cost but added 10–15ms to p95. Need that in slides.
Lina Garcia: Yup — I have a draft slide. Quick note: the KV-cache warmups are affecting p95 on short prompts; I will call that out.
Emma Rogers: Time options: Wed 15:00 PT (23:00 UTC) or Wed 11:00 PT (19:00 UTC). Which is better for EMEA folks?
Maria Ortiz: 19:00 UTC is rough for EMEA, 23:00 UTC is better for us. If we do 23:00 UTC can we keep it to 25m?
Cheng Li: OK let's prefer Wed 15:00 PT (23:00 UTC) then. I'll snag a 30m calendar slot but request strict 25m. If someone can't make it please add comments to the deck.
Lina Garcia: Quick ask — can someone paste the exact command used to generate the cost numbers? Want to reproduce locally.
Samir Patel: command we used: `python tools/bench/export_costs.py --run 2026-03-10 --agg p50,p95 --units tokens`
Cheng Li: Lina — can you also add a 1-slide appendix with the raw logs + links to the run so infra can triage if needed.
Lina Garcia: Will do. Also planning to add a one-line recommendation at the end: "promote q4-8bit to staging for further evals" unless we see quality regressions.
Emma Rogers: Should we add a quick canary plan (who watches, rollback signal)? Might save time during rollout.
Maria Ortiz: +1 on canary plan. Product wants a simple metric and a playbook: %requests with >2s generation, and a subjective quality check on N=50 prompts.
Cheng Li: Great — I'll append canary bullets. Who can be the on-call for the initial staging rollout? @Samir?
Samir Patel: I can be primary for the first 48h.
Cheng Li: Awesome. I'll create the calendar invite and attach the draft deck. Ping here once you've added slides so I can finalize the agenda.
calendar-bot: Cheng Li scheduled: "Inference perf readout — deck + canary plan" Wed 15:00 PT (23:00 UTC), 30m, guests: eng-ml, eng-runtime, product. Conference link: https://meet.redwood/abcd1234
Cheng Li: Bump — if you plan to add slides pls do so by Tue EOD PT so people can pre-read.
Emma Rogers: Adding pre-read comments + a 1-slide summary for execs.
Lina Garcia: Slides uploaded to the meeting folder: https://drive.redwood/infer-readouts/2026-03-10/deck-v1.pptx
Samir Patel: Added batching comparison table and the repro command to appendix.
Maria Ortiz: I'll add a customer-impact example to slide 3.
Cheng Li: Perfect. See you Wed. :thumbsup:
